# Build tile types from actual left components, using fixed orientation. All masks are solid rectangles.
from collections import defaultdict
# right foreground coordinates local (r,c) relative panel cols 12..19
T={(r,c-12) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c in range(12,20) if row[c]==3}
# build component tiles ordered by normalized bbox; colors retained
left_sorted=sorted(left_comps,key=lambda cc:(min(r for r,c in cc),min(c for r,c in cc)))
tiles=[]
for co in left_sorted:
 r0=min(r for r,c in co);r1=max(r for r,c in co);c0=min(c for r,c in co);c1=max(c for r,c in co)
 arr=tuple(tuple(grid[r][c] if (r,c) in set(co) else None for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
 tiles.append(arr)
# compress identical geometry AND color-pattern types
from collections import Counter
patterns=Counter(tiles)
print('tile types:')
for arr,n in patterns.items(): print(n, len(arr),len(arr[0]),arr)
# Board bit index within 20x8
W=8
idx=lambda p:p[0]*W+p[1]
Tmask=sum(1<<idx(p) for p in T)
# group by pattern, all full rectangular
types=list(patterns)
counts=[patterns[p] for p in types]
placements=[]
for ti,arr in enumerate(types):
 h,w=len(arr),len(arr[0]); ps=[]
 for r in range(20-h+1):
  for c in range(W-w+1):
   coords=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in range(h) for dc in range(w)]
   if all(p in T for p in coords):
    mask=sum(1<<idx(p) for p in coords)
    ps.append((r,c,mask))
 placements.append(ps)
print('nplacements', [len(ps) for ps in placements])
# candidates per board cell, type
cell_options=defaultdict(list)
for ti,ps in enumerate(placements):
 for r,c,mask in ps:
  m=mask
  while m:
   low=m&-m; ii=low.bit_length()-1; m-=low
   cell_options[ii].append((ti,r,c,mask))
# exact-cover recursively; reduce equivalent copies as count per type
sols=[]; nodes=0

def search(covered, rem, chosen):
 global nodes
 nodes+=1
 if covered==Tmask:
  if all(x==0 for x in rem):
   sols.append(chosen.copy())
  return len(sols)>=20
 # if all remaining area mismatch or uncovered sizes? 
 unc=Tmask & ~covered
 # choose uncovered target cell with minimum number valid options
 best=None; bestopts=None
 um=unc
 while um:
  low=um&-um; ii=low.bit_length()-1; um-=low
  opts=[]
  for ti,r,c,mask in cell_options[ii]:
   if rem[ti] and not (mask&covered):
    opts.append((ti,r,c,mask))
  if not opts: return False
  if bestopts is None or len(opts)<len(bestopts):
   best,bestopts=ii,opts
   if len(opts)==1: break
 # sort larger tile first
 bestopts.sort(key=lambda op:-op[3].bit_count())
 for ti,r,c,mask in bestopts:
  rem[ti]-=1
  chosen.append((ti,r,c))
  stop=search(covered|mask,rem,chosen)
  chosen.pop();rem[ti]+=1
  if stop: return True
 return False
search(0,counts.copy(),[])
print('nodes',nodes,'solutions collected',len(sols))
if sols: print('first solution placements',sols[0])
